reason: Adds PLANNING_ITEM_PURGED (Item 4c9e961e, purge Lane 1): the one refusal for writes, comments, restores and retries on a permanently deleted Item and for its purged record versions. Nothing can go: no existing code means 'this text was deleted on purpose', and reusing SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or NOT_FOUND would let a purge hide corruption or make a purge look like corruption.
